item_name: Rothco EMS Emergency Response Holster Set
item_short_desc: Rothco’s EMS Emergency Response Holster Set is an essential kit designed for first responders and paramedics. The set includes everything you need for emergency scenarios: a dual head stethoscope, window punch with pocket clip, lifesaver seat belt cutter, brite-light penlight (batteries included), deluxe EMS shears, bandage scissors, and straight Kelly forceps. The durable holster is crafted from 1000 denier ballistic nylon, ensuring long-lasting performance even in demanding environments.
description: Rothco’s EMS Emergency Response Holster Set is an essential kit designed for first responders and paramedics.
